synth.final_message:
`python3 check.py` prints ALL PASS (27/27 transitions replay exactly).

The rule in `program.py`:

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Words | In each row, legends with a gap of 2 cells or less make one word. The pink legends at x=20 and x=27 are one word, so the cursor skips x=27. |
| Cursor position | On the leftmost legend of a word, 4 cells above the legend row. |
| Action 4 | Moves to the next word. At the end of a row it goes to the next row, and from the last row back to the first. |
| Action 3 | Moves to the previous word. |
| Actions 1, 2 | No change. |

The header comment records two guesses that the data did not confirm:
- **Action 3 wrap:** I did not see action 3 at the start of a row. The code wraps it back the same way as action 4.
- **Actions 1 and 2:** The legends are tagged "editable", but no legend changed in any transition. These actions probably edit legends in some state that the data does not include.
